items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you also had the opportunity to work with Pops, Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: We want to get there, but before we get to Duke we talked about some of the our other heroes, all- the heroes and the purveyors of this music, but you also had the opportunity to work with Pops, Louis Armstrong.
So if you could talk about that, that would be great.
